MediaMessageMetadata.description:
A message's metadata: ``speak`` is the surface's speaker setting when it sent the
message; ``true`` asks for the reply to be spoken. Other keys may be present.

speak.description: speak the reply to this message
speak.title: Speak

MediaMessageMetadata.title: MediaMessageMetadata

MediaPartMetadata.description:
A file part's metadata. A surface may set ``voice`` and ``durationMs`` on a recording;
the server adds ``mediaId`` and ``size`` (and ``durationMs``, ``width``, ``height``
where known) when it stores the file and rewrites the part to a media URL. Other keys
may be present.

voice.description: recorded by a voice control: its transcript is shown
voice.title: Voice

MediaPartMetadata.title: MediaPartMetadata

description:
The media extension's card ``params``: the media types this agent accepts and
produces, its limits, which media services it has, and where its media route is
(``<agent URL><mediaPath>/<taskId>/<mediaId>``).

input.description: media types accepted in a file part of a new message
input.title: Input

maxMessageBytes.description: largest total of a message's file parts, in bytes
maxMessageBytes.title: Maxmessagebytes

mediaPath.description: the media route's path, relative to the agent's URL
mediaPath.title: Mediapath

output.description: media types the agent produces (image/png: generated images; audio/L16;rate=24000;channels=1: spoken replies)
output.title: Output

textToSpeech.description: replies to a message with speak=true are spoken
textToSpeech.title: Texttospeech

title: MediaExtensionParams
